# H-MEM conformance vectors

`vectors.json` is copied unchanged from the Meterless repository, `engines/hmem/conformance/vectors/vectors.json`
(github.com/Meterless/Meterless, commit 1742dec, Oct 19 2026), licensed under the Apache License 2.0.
`tests/test_hmem_conformance.py` is a Python port of that suite's `runner.ts`: the same sections, the same
assertions, run against Runway's `hmem.py`.
